asr.full_text: this is Shah and doge is once again showing one of the cleanest and most consistent range structures in the market and this is exactly the kind of setup where keeping things simple gives you the best results instead of over-complicating your analysis right now price is trading around 0.090 nine and in the last update we clearly marked the mini resistance at 0.095 where price reached perfectly and then dropped back down and now it is heading once again towards the same support at 0.090 so let me ask you this when you see price repeatedly moving between the same levels for weeks do you try to predict a breakout early or do you stay disciplined and trade the range until the market actually shows a confirmed break. What we are seeing here is a textbook range that has been respected for more than a month. Price has tapped the 0.090 support multiple times, bounced from there, moved up towards 0.09 5 and then faced rejection again this cycle has repeated itself again and again with which tells us that both buyers and sellers are very active and consistent at these levels buyers are clearly defending the 0.090 support stepping in every time price comes down while sellers are controlling the 0.090 support stepping in every time price comes down, while sellers are controlling the 0.095 resistance rejecting price whenever it moves up. This balance between buyers and sellers is what creates a stable range. Now price is once again approaching the lower boundary of this range, and this is where things become very interesting. Historically, this zone has been a strong demand area, and unless we see a clear breakdown, the expectation remains the same. As long as Doge continues to hold above 0.090 on a daily closing basis, the structure remains intact. That means the range is still valid and we can expect another bounce from this level followed by a move back towards the 0.095 resistance this is why it is important not to overthink the market when the structure is this clear the best strategy is to follow what price has been doing consistently instead of trying to guess a breakout. Before it happens, at the same time, we must always respect the invalidation if price starts closing below 0.09 zero with strong daily candles, then the range breaks. That is when the structure shifts from sideways to bearish and we can expect continuation towards lower levels. But until that happens, the range is still in play and the probability favors another bounce. This is a perfect example of how simple strategies can be powerful when the market gives clear levels. Stay patient, respect the range, and wait for confirmation before changing your bias. Join Shah.com for free signals and let me know which coin you want me to cover next.
